Prevalence over time

Source: R/desc-plots.R
wgh_plot_prevalence.Rd

Plots prevalence with confidence bands over calendar time (or any ordered variable) from the output of wgh_prevalence().

Usage

wgh_plot_prevalence(
  prev,
  time = "yearvisit",
  colour = "sex",
  facet = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

prev

Output of wgh_prevalence() with a time column.

time

Time column (default "yearvisit").

colour

Column mapped to colour (default "sex").

facet

Optional column to facet by.

...

Display options (see wgh_plot_options()).

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

cl <- wgh_classify(growdat)
pv <- wgh_prevalence(cl[cl$age >= 5, ], "obesity", by = c("sex", "yearvisit"))
wgh_plot_prevalence(pv)

wgh_plot_prevalence(pv, show_ci = FALSE, title = "Obesity by year", y_limits = c(0, 35))
#> Warning: No shared levels found between `names(values)` of the manual scale and the
#> data's fill values.
